fields.purpose: Strength of the defined experience or treatment.
fields.meaning: How consistently focal characters demonstrate effective practical, professional or intellectual skill in consequential tasks. Distinct from intelligence, claimed expertise, power, luck or training merely occurring. Zero means no demonstrated competence, not an unintelligent person. Assess the depicted performance; competence_basis separately records how skill is established.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Strength of the defined experience or treatment.
fields.meaning: Demand for retaining and retrieving names, relationships, clues and earlier details over the assessed work to follow it. Distinct from sustained attention, plot complexity or knowing other installments. Assess an attentive first-time viewer who understands the presentation language; do not assume a particular memory impairment.

fields.purpose: Strength of the defined experience or treatment.
fields.meaning: Demand for working out unstated motives, causal connections or events to follow the work. Distinct from optional deeper interpretation, thematic thought provocation or deliberately unresolved ambiguity. A simple plot may still require substantial inference. Assess an attentive first-time viewer who understands the presentation language.

fields.purpose: Strength of the defined experience or treatment.
fields.meaning: Rate at which consequential new information arrives and must be processed to follow the work, in speech, images or sound. Distinct from total exposition, dialogue quantity, cutting speed and the pace of physical action. Repetition and rapid movement without new information do not by themselves increase this demand.

fields.purpose: Work-level affordance under stated assumptions, not a universal viewer verdict.
fields.meaning: Ease of regaining the narrative thread after a brief distraction or viewing break without rewinding. Assume a first-time viewer who understood the work up to that point and understands its presentation language. Reorientation cues and intelligible scene goals can help. Distinct from continuous background viewing or joining midway without prior context. Higher means easier recovery, not a greater demand; this is a work-level tendency, not a promise for every interruption or viewer.

fields.purpose: Perceptual prominence, independently of narrative importance.
fields.meaning: Perceptual prominence of depicted dance performance or dance sequences across the assessed work, including social, stage, ritual and imagined dance. Independent of dancing's narrative centrality, dance skill or choreography quality. Singing alone, dance-music accompaniment, rhythmic editing and combat choreography do not establish dancing. Zero means no perceptibly featured dancing; a supported fleeting dance can be a trace.

fields.purpose: Narrative importance, independently of mere occurrence.
fields.meaning: Extent to which a protagonist or co-protagonist is characterized and motivated through earlier traumatic experiences. Trauma elsewhere in the story, a single tragic fact or ordinary unhappiness does not establish dependence. Assess narrative emphasis, not a clinical diagnosis. Selections across character fields need not describe the same protagonist.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Strength of the defined experience or treatment.
fields.meaning: Magnetism or persuasive personal appeal displayed by protagonists/co-protagonists toward others or through their presentation. Distinct from attractiveness, morality, actor popularity, competence and acting quality.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Perceptual prominence, independently of narrative importance.
fields.meaning: Prominence of idiosyncratic, unconventional habits and behavior among substantial characters. Not inferred from disability, neurodivergence, nationality or mere outsider status.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Narrative importance, independently of mere occurrence.
fields.meaning: Occult or esoteric ceremonies, invocation or ritual practices matter to the work, whether their supernatural effects are real, ambiguous or disbelieved. Ordinary religious observance alone does not qualify; do not label unfamiliar cultures occult.

fields.purpose: Narrative importance, independently of mere occurrence.
fields.meaning: Social or geographical insulation of a community from outsiders matters to the story. A rural location, secret organization or physically isolated individual alone does not establish an isolated community.

fields.purpose: Strength of the defined experience or treatment.
fields.meaning: Sustained creeping apprehension of an ominous threat, including quiet stretches. Distinct from abrupt startles, brief fear, action urgency, general sadness and simply withholding information.

fields.purpose: Perceptual prominence, independently of narrative importance.
fields.meaning: Perceptual emphasis on natural landscapes or scenic built surroundings across the work. Not production location, setting centrality or an automatic judgment of beauty.
reliability_limits: model recollection may not establish perceptual/production facts

fields.purpose: Strength of the defined experience or treatment.
fields.meaning: Strength of audiovisual cues evoking physical environmental sensations such as dampness, heat, cold, air, surfaces and texture. Distinct from general immersion, emotional intimacy, extreme weather and merely being set outdoors.

fields.purpose: Recurrence over the stated scope, not an exact scene count.
fields.meaning: Recurrence of deliberately staged abrupt startles over the assessed work. Zero means assessed no jump scares; 1 is an isolated rare startle, 5 recurring intermittently, 10 pervasive repetition. Not a scene count, intensity score or artistic-quality judgment. Unknown remains null.

fields.purpose: Strength of the defined experience or treatment.
fields.meaning: Strength of progressive intensification in stakes, consequences or conflict across substantial narrative arcs. Distinct from constant high stakes, fast pace, twist count or increasing darkness. A work may escalate without plot twists.

fields.purpose: Narrative importance, independently of mere occurrence.
fields.meaning: Extraordinary personal abilities beyond ordinary human capability matter to the work, in or outside combat. Superhuman abilities of nonhuman focal characters also qualify; ordinary expertise, technology used as a tool or monsters merely existing does not by itself qualify.

fields.purpose: Narrative importance, independently of mere occurrence.
fields.meaning: Monstrous beings or creatures are a focus of the work, whether threatening, sympathetic or ambiguous. Nonhuman identity or an animal alone does not establish a monster; do not apply this to human social groups.

fields.purpose: Narrative importance, independently of mere occurrence.
fields.meaning: Tracking, pursuing, capturing or eliminating supernatural beings drives substantial activity. Excludes ordinary wildlife hunting and merely encountering, fleeing or befriending supernatural beings.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for storytelling.chronology; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial presentation patterns within scope; select every pattern actually used. Chronological and reverse-chronological strands can coexist. Occasional memories do not establish interleaved timelines; a repeated time loop alone is not reverse chronology. Non-temporal applies to substantial passages not organized by story time.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for storytelling.retelling_structure; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Ways substantially the same events are presented again from different accounts. Parallel storylines alone do not qualify. Complementary accounts add information; conflicting accounts disagree. Select both when both occur; [] when assessed with neither.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for storytelling.tone_progression; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial tone patterns within scope, not an exact timeline or a claim about every episode. Select multiple directions if different arcs use them. Broadly stable applies to substantial stable stretches; alternating tones means repeated switching. Comedy and horror blended throughout do not alone establish comic_to_horror.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for characters.competence_basis; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: How focal characters' demonstrated skill is established. These are whole-work categories, not claims that all tags describe the same person. Do not equate intelligence with competence.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for presentation.narration_sources; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Sources of narration or explanatory speech, excluding ordinary dialogue. First-person character narration does not imply direct audience address. Source recordings are retained historical/archival speech rather than newly added explanation.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for presentation.jump_scares; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Abrupt audiovisual events deliberately staged to startle. General fear, loudness or sustained tension alone is not a jump scare.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for presentation.jump_scare_modalities; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Modalities used by actual jump scares, independently of sound-design prominence. Empty only when assessed absent; null when undetermined.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for presentation.laugh_track; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Recorded or live audience laughter included in the soundtrack; ordinary characters laughing is excluded.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for presentation.sustained_screaming; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Extended or repeatedly sustained screaming in the soundtrack, distinct from an isolated shout or startle.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for ending.post_credits_function; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Functions of scenes during or after credits within the assessed edition. Select all that apply, including multiple functions in one scene. [] means no qualifying scene/functions; null means undetermined. A comic tag need not reopen a threat.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for series.case_resolution_pattern; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Recurring case/problem resolution patterns in the assessed episodes. Select all substantial patterns; [] when there is no case/problem structure. Not cancellation status, ending quality or a promise about unseen seasons.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for series.character_continuity; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial continuity patterns for character relationships/development across the assessed episodes. Resetting some strands and developing others can coexist. Independently assessed from case resolution.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.eras; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial depicted story eras, not production dates. A brief mention or prop does not establish a setting. Ancient/medieval are broad temporal labels, not a claim that all societies share one historical periodization.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.relative_periods; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial story periods relative to the title's original release, not today. Multiple selections describe the work overall, without pairing each period to an event.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.reality_layers; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Kinds of depicted reality that matter to the work. Physical staged reality (e.g. an elaborate set) is distinct from a digital simulation or virtual reality.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.environmental_obstacles; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Environmental conditions that materially impede action or survival. Scenic weather alone does not qualify; these tags do not identify who is obstructed or when.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for seasonal.depicted_seasons; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial seasons depicted, based on the setting's local climate/calendar. Release month and viewing associations are insufficient.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for seasonal.depicted_holidays; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Named celebrations actually depicted or materially organizing the story. This bounded vocabulary is not exhaustive; do not invent a new label for an unlisted tradition.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for cultural.movements_and_traditions; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Established artistic affiliation or substantial recognizable stylistic tradition. Country, language, slow pacing or production date alone is insufficient. This list is bounded; unlisted traditions require a future schema revision, not a guessed synonym.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for cultural.depicted_contexts; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Social/cultural experiences substantially depicted, independently of the production industry or an actor's identity. Diaspora and indigenous contexts require established depiction, not inference from appearance.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for representation.established_protagonist_traits; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Explicitly established traits of protagonists/co-protagonists; tags need not describe the same person. Never infer from actor identity, appearance, names or stereotypes. Adult can overlap older_adult. Older_adult follows the score definition: established about 65+ or explicit late-life/elderly stage in the setting; middle age and parenthood alone do not qualify.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.production_method; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial production methods used. Select both for live-action/animation combinations; ordinary CGI visual effects alone do not make a live-action work animated.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.narrative_mode; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Modes used in substantial passages; select fiction and nonfiction for an explicit hybrid. A fictional mockumentary is fiction, not nonfiction merely because it imitates a documentary.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.series_structure; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Show formats within the supplied scope. Limited means deliberately conceived as a bounded limited series/miniseries, not merely a show that eventually ended or has finitely many released seasons. It can coexist with episodic, serialized or anthology structure. Release/cancellation status does not establish limited format.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.color_process; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial color presentation modes in the assessed edition. Select color and black_and_white if both occur; tinting can coexist with an underlying monochrome image.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.adaptation_type; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Source-material types contributing substantially. Multiple sources may coexist; original refers to substantial independently originated material, not every small adaptation change. Do not invent source-work identifiers.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.factual_basis; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Relationships to real people/events within scope; multiple selections may apply. Disputed is supported factual controversy, not the model being unsure. No selection certifies accuracy.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.animation_techniques; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Animation techniques actually used, not creatures depicted. Select each substantial technique instead of a generic mixed tag.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.presentation_modes; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Observable presentation modes, not audience approval.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.documentary_devices; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Devices used in documentary-style presentation, including fictional mockumentary. Voiceover origin is captured separately.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.capture_media; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Known original capture media. Populate only from specific production knowledge or supplied evidence; otherwise null. A digital streaming release, animation, simulated grain, release date or assumed industry practice does not establish capture medium. Multiple known media may coexist; do not invent components of a mixed-format label.
reliability_limits: model recollection may not establish perceptual/production facts

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.work_relation_types; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Known relation types to other works; these tags do not resolve target works or establish influence from resemblance alone.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.anime_tradition; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Affiliation with the anime production/artistic tradition; animation alone is insufficient.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.silent_or_intertitles; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Principally silent-film/intertitle presentation, not simply sparse dialogue.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.single_take_presentation; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Whole work presented as one continuous take, real or simulated; an isolated long take is insufficient.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.real_time_presentation; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Main narrative is presented approximately in real elapsed time; not merely rapid plot events.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.post_credits_scene_present; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: A scene during/after credits in this edition, not ordinary credit text.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for format_facts.alternate_endings_present; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Known alternative endings for this title/edition; do not invent them from narrative ambiguity.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for performance.dance_styles; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Recognizable dance styles actually depicted in the assessed work, independently of narrative importance. Select all supported styles, including overlaps. Do not infer a style from soundtrack genre, production country, costume alone or combat movement. Broad folk_traditional is not a claim about a particular named tradition; other means a known depicted style outside this bounded vocabulary. Null means the styles cannot be assessed; [] means no listed style identified, not certified absence of all dancing.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for performance.dance_contexts; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Contexts in which dancing is actually depicted. Select all supported contexts; styles and contexts are whole-work sets and need not describe the same sequence. Narrative musical number includes imagined or expressive dance, not singing alone. Stage performance is different from everyday social dancing; rehearsal is not automatically competition. Null means undetermined; [] means no listed context identified.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for visuals.dominant_colors; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Sustained visually dominant on-screen colors, from grading, lighting, costumes or design. Exclude a single prop or fleeting image, posters and assumed symbolism. Multiple selections need not appear together; black/white/gray describe tonal dominance, not automatically monochrome presentation.
reliability_limits: model recollection may not establish perceptual/production facts

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for visuals.palette_patterns; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial on-screen palette relationships, regardless of production technique. Monochromatic means a narrow hue family, not necessarily black-and-white. Analogous uses neighboring hues; complementary uses opposing hues; selective_color isolates colors against subdued/monochrome surroundings; changing_palettes requires substantial palette shifts.
reliability_limits: model recollection may not establish perceptual/production facts

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for characters.protagonist_motivations; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial established motives of protagonists/co-protagonists, not every action or an inferred diagnosis. Whole-work set; wealth and power need not motivate the same person. Revenge is not automatically a tragic-backstory dependence.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for characters.protagonist_behavioral_traits; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Sustained behavior of protagonists/co-protagonists. Cunning means strategic guile; manipulative means steering others through calculated influence; ruthless means willingness to disregard others welfare for an aim. Self_destructive means repeatedly acting against own welfare. These do not follow automatically from competence, antihero status or identity. Tags may describe different leads.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for characters.protagonist_arc_patterns; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial protagonist patterns, not inferred from a single mood or scene. Social_alienation is estrangement/exclusion; accumulated_frustration is sustained mounting dissatisfaction; destructive_rebellion is resistance through damaging or destructive acts. They need not co-occur in one protagonist. Other arc attributes remain independently assessed.
reliability_limits: no identity inference from actors/stereotypes; flat tags not person-linked

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for groups.types; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Kinds of substantially depicted organized groups. Militant requires endorsement or use of combative/coercive force in pursuit of aims, not merely strong beliefs. Ideological describes organizing shared doctrine; political describes political aims. Secrecy, religion, ethnicity or outsider unfamiliarity alone does not establish militancy or coercion.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for groups.encounter_perspectives; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Sustained focal perspectives through which an organized group is encountered: newcomer joins or enters its world; journalist investigates/reports; undercover conceals investigative identity; visitor remains outside; insider depicts established membership; defector leaves. Whole-work selections need not concern the same group or character.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for groups.internal_dynamics; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantially depicted internal group processes. Operational_methods means showing how a group pursues its aims; mere group presence is insufficient. Select only established processes, not stereotypes about the group type.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for relationships.friendship_dynamics; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial dynamics within depicted friendships: mutual care, recurring friction, attempted repair, enabling harmful choices, and unresolved strain. Repair does not imply success or complete resolution. Different tags may concern different friendships; not an assertion of realism or overall ending closure.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for relationships.romance_social_dynamics; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial romantic relationship dynamics: concealment, social disapproval, public scandal or conflicting loyalties. Secrecy is not necessarily shame or infidelity; disapproval needs depiction, not the assessor judging identities. Whole-work tags need not concern the same romance.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.depicted_weather; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial perceptible weather/atmospheric conditions, whether scenic or obstructive. Humid requires cues of damp heavy air; tropical geography or rain alone does not establish humidity. Do not infer conditions solely from season, production location or a storm-related plot reference.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.built_environment_character; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial depicted qualities of built surroundings. Old_historic denotes visibly/established older structures; decaying denotes deterioration, independently of age, poverty, haunting or visual beauty.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.depicted_regions; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Broad real-world geographical story settings substantially depicted, not filming locations, production countries, character ancestry or travel aspirations. Transregional stories can select multiple. Fictional or unidentified geography stays untagged/unknown rather than guessed; this bounded field does not supply country-level precision.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for sound.ambient_sources; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Sources with substantial audible environmental presence, independently of narrative importance. Do not infer audible sound from visible objects or setting. Natural ambience can be designed or recorded; this makes no recording-technique claim.
reliability_limits: model recollection may not establish perceptual/production facts

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for advisory_details.animal_harm_types; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Kinds of threatened or actual animal harm depicted or explicitly referred to. Deliberate_cruelty denotes intentional abuse or torment, including neglect; it is distinct from an accidental injury or natural death. Threats can coexist with cruelty. Different tags need not concern the same animal. Unknown parent presence requires null; assessed absent parent requires []; none of these are independently verified exclusion guarantees.

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.predominant_eras; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Main substantial story eras by narrative emphasis. Multiple selections require genuinely balanced major timelines; a brief flashback is insufficient. Select only eras also assessed in world_context.eras. Unknown remains null.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.depicted_decades; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Substantial established story decades normalized to real-world BCE/CE chronology, within the fixed 1800s–2190s vocabulary. Never substitute release decades or copy fictional calendar numbers. Use only when calendar correspondence is established. Null when undetermined; [] when assessed and no listed decade applies. Broad eras can remain known while exact decades/years remain unknown.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.predominant_decades; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Main story decades by narrative emphasis, normalized to real-world BCE/CE chronology. Each must occur in depicted_decades. Do not copy a fictional calendar number, release decade or aesthetic period. Null when correspondence or dominant decade is unknown; multiple choices require substantial major timelines.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Exact normalized story-time boundary only when established; not a release date or inferred decade endpoint.
fields.meaning: Earliest specifically established substantial story year normalized to real-world BCE/CE. -1 is 1 BCE and 1 is 1 CE; no year zero. Never use release years, costume/set aesthetics, broad era estimates or unconverted fictional-calendar numbers. Null unless this exact boundary and its calendar correspondence are known; a known decade need not imply known year bounds. Brief flashbacks do not set substantial bounds.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Exact normalized story-time boundary only when established; not a release date or inferred decade endpoint.
fields.meaning: Latest specifically established substantial story year normalized to real-world BCE/CE. -1 is 1 BCE and 1 is 1 CE; no year zero. Never use release years, costume/set aesthetics, broad era estimates or unconverted fictional-calendar numbers. Null unless this exact boundary and its calendar correspondence are known; a known decade need not imply known year bounds. A range does not assert continuous coverage.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference

fields.purpose: Bounded categorical or factual distinction for world_context.calendar_systems; permits supported overlap and explicit unknown.
fields.meaning: Calendar systems or established chronology correspondence for substantial story settings. real_world_ce_bce means established correspondence with real-world historical chronology, including alternate histories retaining that calendar. other_real_world means an identified non-CE real-world calendar; fictional means an invented calendar or epoch. If a non-CE or fictional calendar has an explicitly known BCE/CE conversion, also select real_world_ce_bce. Multiple can coexist. Do not infer from a four-digit year, release date or contemporary appearance. Null if undetermined; [] if assessed with no established calendar. Numeric year/decade fields always require known BCE/CE correspondence; this field does not supply a conversion.
reliability_limits: story setting, never release/production inference
